**Best move:** Ng3+

**Main line:** Ng3+ hxg3 Rh5#

**Motif:** attraction, sacrifice

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's king looks cramped, check if sacrificing a piece can force it into a mating net. Here, Ng3+ lures White's h-pawn to capture, opening the h-file. The rook then delivers unstoppable mate on h5 because the king has no escape squares. Look for forcing moves (checks first!) when you're down material—they often hide tactical wins.
